quest.title: Lost Book
quest.description: Many people forget to return the library books they've borrowed, leaving Lisa no choice but to chase them and retrieve the books. Marjorie and Sara have agreed to return the books they borrowed as soon as possible, but Donna's seems to have been stolen. You decide to track the missing book down by following the trail left by an elemental marking Lisa made on it.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Primogem x60, Mora x9475, Teachings of Ballad x5, 1000 Years of Loneliness x1, Adventurer's Experience x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It must be nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Using <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>, you can even detect <color=#00E1FFFF>magic</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Follow the flow of <color=#00E1FFFF>magic</color> to find the book.

talks.objective: Find out which way the elemental marks lead

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The elemental traces are strong here, but it seems our thief <color=#00E1FFFF>did not stay for long</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The thief lives inside <color=#00E1FFFF>ruins</color>? Mondstadt people do have some strange quirks.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Please do not jump to such a preposterous conclusion about the living habits of Mondstadt's residents.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This seems far more likely to be the work of some none-too-friendly troublemakers.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Stealing books is hardly the hilichurls' style.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All they would use books for is to keep their campfire going anyway.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: This is more likely to be the <color=#00E1FFFF>Abyss Order's</color> doing. They do seem to have a way of slipping in and out of places like ghosts, after all.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Also... There is an elemental seal at the entrance. It looks like the result of an Abyss Mage's magic.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A seal? How are we gonna break it? Is this gonna turn into another huge ordeal?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Not to worry. If you think a little magic can keep me out, think again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why is that?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Come on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this is what Lisa's like when she's hard at work...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It's like you can read my mind.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It's not unlike them, in the sense that they are known for darting around amongst underground ruins.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But Adventurers do not typically take others' belongings... Well, not from the living, anyway.

talks.objective: Enter the book thief's hiding place

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so much bigger in here than Paimon thought...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: How did you find this place!? It's... so well hidden!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I have no interest in finding out where you little rascals hide yourselves away. But I do want my book back.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Tell me, how is it that you have the time to conceal your stronghold and apply a magic seal — but not to sign out a library book in the proper manner?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: You have no respect whatsoever for other people's work.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: ...You— You just want... <color=#00E1FFFF>the book</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: I was unaware that anyone in Mondstadt was concerned with unearthing the secret hidden inside this book...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: Who... Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The librarian. Although, I believe that should be quite clear already.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Return the book. This is an ultimatum.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: Hmph. Since you insist on concealing your identity...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: I have all the less reason to give you that book.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: After all, it contains... the secret...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: Huh!? Wh—What are you doing!? Such concentrated elemental power! P—Please don't—

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Mage
dialogues.text: *shrieking*

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmph. Naughty boys who don't do what they're told need a little punishment to keep them in line.

choices.text: You didn't let him finish speaking...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: *sigh* This is why I call it troublesome work.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: We'll just need to find the book ourselves. It should be around here somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's <color=#00E1FFFF>The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies</color>! Paimon remembers that name, is this the one you were looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: That's the one. It's a good thing it isn't damaged, otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Otherwise what? Are you telling me you have even more crazy punishments up your sleeve!?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe. I would probably have needed to dish out a little taste of one of my potions in that case.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Then again... As I said, it isn't from the restricted section. Which is the only reason I would let the average citizen borrow it in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And it doesn't appear to have any abnormal elemental properties, save for the markings I put on it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... It seems like just an average storybook.

choices.text: So why did the Abyss Order...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (How mysterious. I'm so curious...)

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As far as my duties as a librarian go, my troublesome work is finished.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Since this book has piqued your interest, why don't I let you borrow it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please don't punish me if I return it late...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: There's no time limit for you. I will register you as "custodian" rather than "borrower."

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: This is an exclusive privilege reserved for trusted citizens only.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exclusive privilege? Why does Paimon feel this is just your sneaky way of offloading your troublesome work onto someone else?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Excuse me? Are you in some way dissatisfied with my work?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will take extra special care of this book...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Good. You are amenable to reason then. I do wish I could keep you by my side as my personal assistant...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: My work here is done. I'm going back.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Don't forget to register at the library when you have a spare moment.

choices.text: I will take extra special care of this book...
Please don't punish me if I return it late...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, you've returned. The paperwork is done — you are now the custodian of this book.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you Miss Lisa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...But Paimon thinks we're forgetting something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, over there on the shelf! Isn't that the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color>?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And look how many copies there are!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe... The <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> is a serial publication. It is not part of the library's formal collection.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Take one. Consider it your compensation for being Lisa's little helper today.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: With you by my side, my troublesome work was a little less dull than usual.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! The Teyvat Travel Guide was just bait to get us to do a day's work!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I hadn't anticipated that a few routine returns inquiries would take us out of the city, let alone down into some underground ruins.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As compensation for dragging you into all this bother, take these souvenirs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Lisa went and bought us some special souvenirs!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: In fact, they were intended for our next outing, but... Never mind, we can discuss next time's activity when the time comes. I hope you are looking forward to it.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: *yawn*

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You are a voracious one, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> is on the bookcase next to you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: No need to return it.
